SELECT CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-records') AS BIGINT) AS total_records
FROM (
  SELECT summary, committed_at, 'transactions' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT summary, committed_at, 'users' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT summary, committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_32' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_32$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT summary, committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_4' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_4$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT summary, committed_at, 'transactions_by_minute' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_minute$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT summary, committed_at, 'transactions_by_date' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_date$snapshots"
)
WHERE tbl = '${target_table}'
ORDER BY committed_at DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT count(*) AS total_commits
FROM (
  SELECT 'transactions' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'users' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'transactions_by_user_32' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_32$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'transactions_by_user_4' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_4$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'transactions_by_minute' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_minute$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'transactions_by_date' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_date$snapshots"
)
WHERE tbl = '${target_table}'

SELECT
  CASE WHEN total_data_files > 0
       THEN round(CAST(total_files_size_bytes AS DOUBLE) / total_data_files / 1024.0, 2)
       ELSE 0 END AS avg_file_size_kb
FROM (
  SELECT
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) AS total_data_files,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-files-size')  AS BIGINT) AS total_files_size_bytes,
    committed_at,
    tbl
  FROM (
    SELECT summary, committed_at, 'transactions' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT summary, committed_at, 'users' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT summary, committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_32' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_32$snapshots"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT summary, committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_4' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_4$snapshots"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT summary, committed_at, 'transactions_by_minute' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_minute$snapshots"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT summary, committed_at, 'transactions_by_date' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_date$snapshots"
  )
  WHERE tbl = '${target_table}'
  ORDER BY committed_at DESC LIMIT 1
)

SELECT date_diff('minute', max(committed_at), now()) AS minutes_since_last_commit
FROM (
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'users' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_32' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_32$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_4' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_4$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_minute' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_minute$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_date' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_date$snapshots"
)
WHERE tbl = '${target_table}'

SELECT
  from_unixtime(floor(to_unixtime(committed_at) / 300.0) * 300) AS time,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'transactions')            AS transactions,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'users')                   AS users,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'transactions_by_user_32')    AS transactions_by_user_32,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'transactions_by_user_4')  AS transactions_by_user_4,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'transactions_by_minute')  AS transactions_by_minute,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'transactions_by_date')    AS transactions_by_date
FROM (
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'users'        AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_32'   AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_32$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_4' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_4$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_minute' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_minute$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_date'   AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_date$snapshots"
)
WHERE tbl IN (${target_table:singlequote})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  from_unixtime(floor(to_unixtime(committed_at) / 300.0) * 300) AS time,
  coalesce(sum(added_records) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'transactions'), 0)            AS transactions,
  coalesce(sum(added_records) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'users'),        0)            AS users,
  coalesce(sum(added_records) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'transactions_by_user_32'),   0)  AS transactions_by_user_32,
  coalesce(sum(added_records) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'transactions_by_user_4'), 0)  AS transactions_by_user_4,
  coalesce(sum(added_records) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'transactions_by_minute'), 0)  AS transactions_by_minute,
  coalesce(sum(added_records) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'transactions_by_date'),   0)  AS transactions_by_date
FROM (
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions' AS tbl,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-records') AS BIGINT) AS added_records
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'users' AS tbl,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-records') AS BIGINT) AS added_records
  FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_32' AS tbl,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-records') AS BIGINT) AS added_records
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_32$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_4' AS tbl,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-records') AS BIGINT) AS added_records
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_4$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_minute' AS tbl,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-records') AS BIGINT) AS added_records
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_minute$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_date' AS tbl,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-records') AS BIGINT) AS added_records
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_date$snapshots"
)
WHERE tbl IN (${target_table:singlequote})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  committed_at AS time,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions'            THEN CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-records') AS BIGINT) END) AS transactions,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'users'                   THEN CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-records') AS BIGINT) END) AS users,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions_by_user_32'    THEN CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-records') AS BIGINT) END) AS transactions_by_user_32,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions_by_user_4'  THEN CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-records') AS BIGINT) END) AS transactions_by_user_4,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions_by_minute'  THEN CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-records') AS BIGINT) END) AS transactions_by_minute,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions_by_date'    THEN CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-records') AS BIGINT) END) AS transactions_by_date
FROM (
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions' AS tbl, summary FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'users'        AS tbl, summary FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_32'   AS tbl, summary FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_32$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_4' AS tbl, summary FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_4$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_minute' AS tbl, summary FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_minute$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_date'   AS tbl, summary FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_date$snapshots"
)
WHERE tbl IN (${target_table:singlequote})
GROUP BY committed_at
ORDER BY committed_at

SELECT
  table_name,
  file_count,
  total_records,
  avg_records_per_file,
  min_records_per_file,
  max_records_per_file,
  avg_file_size_kb,
  min_file_size_kb,
  max_file_size_kb,
  total_size_mb
FROM (
  SELECT
    'transactions' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS file_count,
    sum(record_count) AS total_records,
    round(CAST(avg(record_count) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS avg_records_per_file,
    min(record_count) AS min_records_per_file,
    max(record_count) AS max_records_per_file,
    round(CAST(avg(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS avg_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(min(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS min_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(max(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS max_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(sum(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) AS total_size_mb
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$files"
  WHERE content = 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'users' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS file_count,
    sum(record_count) AS total_records,
    round(CAST(avg(record_count) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS avg_records_per_file,
    min(record_count) AS min_records_per_file,
    max(record_count) AS max_records_per_file,
    round(CAST(avg(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS avg_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(min(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS min_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(max(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS max_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(sum(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) AS total_size_mb
  FROM iceberg.demo."users$files"
  WHERE content = 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'transactions_by_user_32' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS file_count,
    sum(record_count) AS total_records,
    round(CAST(avg(record_count) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS avg_records_per_file,
    min(record_count) AS min_records_per_file,
    max(record_count) AS max_records_per_file,
    round(CAST(avg(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS avg_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(min(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS min_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(max(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS max_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(sum(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) AS total_size_mb
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_32$files"
  WHERE content = 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'transactions_by_user_4' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS file_count,
    sum(record_count) AS total_records,
    round(CAST(avg(record_count) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS avg_records_per_file,
    min(record_count) AS min_records_per_file,
    max(record_count) AS max_records_per_file,
    round(CAST(avg(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS avg_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(min(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS min_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(max(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS max_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(sum(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) AS total_size_mb
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_4$files"
  WHERE content = 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'transactions_by_minute' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS file_count,
    sum(record_count) AS total_records,
    round(CAST(avg(record_count) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS avg_records_per_file,
    min(record_count) AS min_records_per_file,
    max(record_count) AS max_records_per_file,
    round(CAST(avg(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS avg_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(min(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS min_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(max(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS max_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(sum(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) AS total_size_mb
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_minute$files"
  WHERE content = 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'transactions_by_date' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS file_count,
    sum(record_count) AS total_records,
    round(CAST(avg(record_count) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS avg_records_per_file,
    min(record_count) AS min_records_per_file,
    max(record_count) AS max_records_per_file,
    round(CAST(avg(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS avg_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(min(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS min_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(max(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS max_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(sum(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) AS total_size_mb
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_date$files"
  WHERE content = 0
)
WHERE table_name IN (${target_table:singlequote})

SELECT
  committed_at AS time,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions' AND total_data_files > 0
      THEN round(CAST(total_files_size AS DOUBLE) / total_data_files / 1024.0, 2) END) AS transactions,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'users' AND total_data_files > 0
      THEN round(CAST(total_files_size AS DOUBLE) / total_data_files / 1024.0, 2) END) AS users,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions_by_user_32' AND total_data_files > 0
      THEN round(CAST(total_files_size AS DOUBLE) / total_data_files / 1024.0, 2) END) AS transactions_by_user_32,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions_by_minute' AND total_data_files > 0
      THEN round(CAST(total_files_size AS DOUBLE) / total_data_files / 1024.0, 2) END) AS transactions_by_minute,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions_by_date' AND total_data_files > 0
      THEN round(CAST(total_files_size AS DOUBLE) / total_data_files / 1024.0, 2) END) AS transactions_by_date
FROM (
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions' AS tbl,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-files-size') AS BIGINT) AS total_files_size,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) AS total_data_files
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'users' AS tbl,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-files-size') AS BIGINT) AS total_files_size,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) AS total_data_files
  FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_32' AS tbl,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-files-size') AS BIGINT) AS total_files_size,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) AS total_data_files
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_32$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_4' AS tbl,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-files-size') AS BIGINT) AS total_files_size,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) AS total_data_files
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_4$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_minute' AS tbl,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-files-size') AS BIGINT) AS total_files_size,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) AS total_data_files
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_minute$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_date' AS tbl,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-files-size') AS BIGINT) AS total_files_size,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) AS total_data_files
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_date$snapshots"
)
WHERE tbl IN (${target_table:singlequote})
GROUP BY committed_at
ORDER BY committed_at

WITH txn_manifests AS (
  SELECT 'transactions' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS active_manifest_count,
    sum(added_data_files_count) AS added_data_files,
    sum(existing_data_files_count) AS existing_data_files,
    sum(deleted_data_files_count) AS pending_deleted_files,
    sum(added_rows_count) AS added_rows,
    sum(existing_rows_count) AS existing_rows,
    sum(deleted_rows_count) AS pending_deleted_rows
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$manifests"
),
txn_snap_count AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total_snapshot_count FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
),
usr_manifests AS (
  SELECT 'users' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS active_manifest_count,
    sum(added_data_files_count) AS added_data_files,
    sum(existing_data_files_count) AS existing_data_files,
    sum(deleted_data_files_count) AS pending_deleted_files,
    sum(added_rows_count) AS added_rows,
    sum(existing_rows_count) AS existing_rows,
    sum(deleted_rows_count) AS pending_deleted_rows
  FROM iceberg.demo."users$manifests"
),
usr_snap_count AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total_snapshot_count FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
),
byu_manifests AS (
  SELECT 'transactions_by_user_32' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS active_manifest_count,
    sum(added_data_files_count) AS added_data_files,
    sum(existing_data_files_count) AS existing_data_files,
    sum(deleted_data_files_count) AS pending_deleted_files,
    sum(added_rows_count) AS added_rows,
    sum(existing_rows_count) AS existing_rows,
    sum(deleted_rows_count) AS pending_deleted_rows
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_32$manifests"
),
byu_snap_count AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total_snapshot_count FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_32$snapshots"
),
byu4_manifests AS (
  SELECT 'transactions_by_user_4' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS active_manifest_count,
    sum(added_data_files_count) AS added_data_files,
    sum(existing_data_files_count) AS existing_data_files,
    sum(deleted_data_files_count) AS pending_deleted_files,
    sum(added_rows_count) AS added_rows,
    sum(existing_rows_count) AS existing_rows,
    sum(deleted_rows_count) AS pending_deleted_rows
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_4$manifests"
),
byu4_snap_count AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total_snapshot_count FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_4$snapshots"
),
bym_manifests AS (
  SELECT 'transactions_by_minute' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS active_manifest_count,
    sum(added_data_files_count) AS added_data_files,
    sum(existing_data_files_count) AS existing_data_files,
    sum(deleted_data_files_count) AS pending_deleted_files,
    sum(added_rows_count) AS added_rows,
    sum(existing_rows_count) AS existing_rows,
    sum(deleted_rows_count) AS pending_deleted_rows
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_minute$manifests"
),
bym_snap_count AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total_snapshot_count FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_minute$snapshots"
),
byd_manifests AS (
  SELECT 'transactions_by_date' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS active_manifest_count,
    sum(added_data_files_count) AS added_data_files,
    sum(existing_data_files_count) AS existing_data_files,
    sum(deleted_data_files_count) AS pending_deleted_files,
    sum(added_rows_count) AS added_rows,
    sum(existing_rows_count) AS existing_rows,
    sum(deleted_rows_count) AS pending_deleted_rows
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_date$manifests"
),
byd_snap_count AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total_snapshot_count FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_date$snapshots"
)
SELECT m.table_name, m.active_manifest_count, s.total_snapshot_count,
  greatest(0, s.total_snapshot_count - m.active_manifest_count) AS est_orphaned_manifests,
  m.added_data_files, m.existing_data_files, m.pending_deleted_files,
  m.added_rows, m.existing_rows, m.pending_deleted_rows
FROM txn_manifests m, txn_snap_count s
WHERE 'transactions' IN (${target_table:singlequote})
UNION ALL
SELECT m.table_name, m.active_manifest_count, s.total_snapshot_count,
  greatest(0, s.total_snapshot_count - m.active_manifest_count) AS est_orphaned_manifests,
  m.added_data_files, m.existing_data_files, m.pending_deleted_files,
  m.added_rows, m.existing_rows, m.pending_deleted_rows
FROM usr_manifests m, usr_snap_count s
WHERE 'users' IN (${target_table:singlequote})

SELECT m.table_name, m.active_manifest_count, s.total_snapshot_count,

FROM byu_manifests m, byu_snap_count s
WHERE 'transactions_by_user_32' IN (${target_table:singlequote})
UNION ALL
SELECT m.table_name, m.active_manifest_count, s.total_snapshot_count,
  greatest(0, s.total_snapshot_count - m.active_manifest_count) AS est_orphaned_manifests,
  m.added_data_files, m.existing_data_files, m.pending_deleted_files,
  m.added_rows, m.existing_rows, m.pending_deleted_rows
FROM byu4_manifests m, byu4_snap_count s

UNION ALL
SELECT m.table_name, m.active_manifest_count, s.total_snapshot_count,
  greatest(0, s.total_snapshot_count - m.active_manifest_count) AS est_orphaned_manifests,
  m.added_data_files, m.existing_data_files, m.pending_deleted_files,
  m.added_rows, m.existing_rows, m.pending_deleted_rows
FROM bym_manifests m, bym_snap_count s
WHERE 'transactions_by_minute' IN (${target_table:singlequote})
UNION ALL
SELECT m.table_name, m.active_manifest_count, s.total_snapshot_count,
  greatest(0, s.total_snapshot_count - m.active_manifest_count) AS est_orphaned_manifests,
  m.added_data_files, m.existing_data_files, m.pending_deleted_files,
  m.added_rows, m.existing_rows, m.pending_deleted_rows
FROM byd_manifests m, byd_snap_count s
WHERE 'transactions_by_date' IN (${target_table:singlequote})

),
daily AS (
  SELECT table_name, date_trunc('day', committed_at) AS day,
    coalesce(sum(added_records), 0) AS total_added_records
  FROM snapshots
  GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT
  day AS time,
  sum(total_added_records) FILTER (WHERE table_name = 'transactions')            AS transactions,
  sum(total_added_records) FILTER (WHERE table_name = 'users')                   AS users,

  sum(total_added_records) FILTER (WHERE table_name = 'transactions_by_date')    AS transactions_by_date

panels.title: Partition Distribution (partitioned tables)
panels.description: Partition-level statistics for the three partitioned transaction tables. skew_ratio = (max − min) / avg records per partition; values >> 1 indicate uneven distribution.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  table_name,
  partition_count,
  total_records,
  min_records,
  max_records,
  round(CAST(avg_records AS DOUBLE), 0) AS avg_records,
  total_files,
  round(CAST(total_size_bytes AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) AS total_size_mb,
  round(CAST(max_records - min_records AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(avg_records AS DOUBLE), 0), 2) AS skew_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT
    'transactions_by_user_32' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS partition_count,
    sum(record_count) AS total_records,
    min(record_count) AS min_records,
    max(record_count) AS max_records,
    avg(record_count) AS avg_records,
    sum(file_count) AS total_files,
    sum(total_size) AS total_size_bytes
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_32$partitions"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'transactions_by_user_4' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS partition_count,
    sum(record_count) AS total_records,
    min(record_count) AS min_records,
    max(record_count) AS max_records,
    avg(record_count) AS avg_records,
    sum(file_count) AS total_files,
    sum(total_size) AS total_size_bytes
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_4$partitions"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'transactions_by_minute' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS partition_count,
    sum(record_count) AS total_records,
    min(record_count) AS min_records,
    max(record_count) AS max_records,
    avg(record_count) AS avg_records,
    sum(file_count) AS total_files,
    sum(total_size) AS total_size_bytes
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_minute$partitions"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'transactions_by_date' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS partition_count,
    sum(record_count) AS total_records,
    min(record_count) AS min_records,
    max(record_count) AS max_records,
    avg(record_count) AS avg_records,
    sum(file_count) AS total_files,
    sum(total_size) AS total_size_bytes
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_date$partitions"
)

panels.title: Partition Count Over Time (partitioned tables)
panels.description: How many distinct partitions each table has accumulated across snapshots. Rapid growth in transactions_by_minute is expected; transactions_by_date grows daily.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  committed_at AS time,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions_by_user_32'
      THEN CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) END) AS txns_by_user_files,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions_by_user_4'
      THEN CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) END) AS txns_by_user_4_files,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions_by_minute'
      THEN CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) END) AS txns_by_minute_files,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions_by_date'
      THEN CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) END) AS txns_by_date_files
FROM (
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_32'   AS tbl, summary FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_32$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_user_4' AS tbl, summary FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_user_4$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_minute' AS tbl, summary FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_minute$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions_by_date'   AS tbl, summary FROM iceberg.demo."transactions_by_date$snapshots"
)
GROUP BY committed_at
ORDER BY committed_at
